newsitem.title: POLAND: WEDEL SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE HOLDING GROUP.
newsitem.headline: WEDEL SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE HOLDING GROUP.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish confectioner Wedel SA have approved management's proposal to transform itself into a holding group encompassing four main subsidiaries to raise efficiency, the firm said in a statement.
The proposal was to create four fully-owned subsidiaries specialising in producing chocolate, salty snacks, biscuits and sweets.

"Proposed changes would help improve Wedel's financial performance and bring long-term benefits for its shareholders by creating a structure which will allow the management to better take account of differences between various market segments," Wedel said last month.
